native_mechanisms: A glint leaves the touched jewel and crawls along every cord at a pace set by that cord's own length, so short cords flash at once and long cords keep the glint waiting en route.
The first flare to arrive at a jewel is chalked once and is final; every later flare arriving along a longer/slacker cord is thrown away unmarked.
A square that never catches any flare stays blank and is crossed out, marking an unreachable place.
core_technique: Delta-stepping SSSP: CSR with light/heavy edge partition and a power-of-two ring of distance buckets (a monotone bucket priority queue, i.e. Dial-style Dijkstra with in-bucket relaxation to a fixpoint), plus an explicit branch to plain O(n^2) array-scan Dijkstra (AVX-vectorised min-scan) for dense or small graphs.
